coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across MARKET/COMPETITIVE leaf covering: (1) T0 primary sources: official pricing pages for Neo4j, Metabase, LlamaIndex, CostBench pricing database; (2) T1 official docs + review aggregates: SoftwareAdvice, G2, Capterra, SaaSworthy, Spotsaas comparison pages; (3) T2 analyst reports: Gartner Magic Quadrant BI/Analytics, Technavio/Mordor/Fortune Business Intelligence market sizing, Gartner data analytics predictions 2026, Forrester SaaS trends; (4) T3 practitioner coverage: tech-insider.org comparative analyses (Tableau vs Power BI, Supabase vs Firebase, Airtable vs Notion pricing gaps with 2.5-50% variances documented), data warehouse TCO guides, SaaS pricing playbooks from $100M+ companies, vector database cost comparison 2026, low-code market analyses, freemium strategy impact studies. Deduplication: merged 150+ sources into 65 unique, high-value URLs per licensing/parser/tier. Angles swept: (a) data visualization tools (Power BI $14-24/user/mo, Tableau $15-75/user/mo, Grafana free-29/mo); (b) graph databases (Neo4j $0-$50K+/yr bundled); (c) low-code/workflow builders (Retool $10-50, Budibase $5-15, Appsmith $0-25/user/mo); (d) open-source alternatives (Metabase free self-hosted, Superset free); (e) vector databases (Pinecone $70-$15K+/mo, Weaviate $135-$3K+/mo, Qdrant $65-$6K/mo); (f) knowledge graph tools (Obsidian $5-10/mo, Roam Research $15/mo); (g) backend/internal tools (Supabase $0-599/mo, Firebase $50-200+/mo); (h) NoSQL pricing (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra $1K-3.5K/yr comparable); (i) SaaS benchmarks: B2B median ACV $26K, SMB $5-15K, enterprise $50K-250K+, usage-based 29% faster growth, hybrid pricing dominant (61% adoption); (j) market growth: BI market $48.6B reaching $72.21B 2034 (8.4-10.4% CAGR), low-code $44.5-52B 2026 growing 19-29% CAGR; (k) tier ladder patterns: 3-4 tiers standard, free tier conversion 2-5%, trial-to-paid 18.5% median, vertical SaaS 18-32% growth vs 12-15% horizontal. Notable gaps: Palantir/enterprise custom pricing (reference-only by design), licensing model detail for open-core (GitLab model documented). Authority coverage: Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Technavio, Mordor, Fortune, Grand View Research; vendor reviews via G2, Capterra, SoftwareAdvice; independent pricing analysis via CostBench (3,224 products), LeanOps (vector DB deep-dive); founder benchmarks via Optifai (939 SaaS companies), Benchmarkit.

sources.title: Neo4j Cloud & Self-Hosted Graph Database Pricing
sources.notes: Official Neo4j pricing page. Community Edition free (GPLv3), Enterprise Edition pricing model, Bloom visualization tool $1.2K-2.5K/user/year, GDS library $10K-50K+/year. Bundled deals achieve 15-25% discounts vs separate purchases.

sources.title: CostBench: Independent Software Pricing Database (3,224 Tools)
sources.notes: Primary database tracking verified daily pricing for 3,224 products, hidden costs across 4,663 fees, negotiated pricing from 940 products via Vendr, side-by-side comparisons (5,850 guides), contract terms documentation.

sources.title: Gartner Magic Quadrant for Analytics and Business Intelligence Platforms 2026
sources.notes: Analyst report on BI platform leaders/challengers evaluated by Ability to Execute and Completeness of Vision. Leaders include Microsoft, Salesforce/Tableau, Google, Qlik, Oracle, ThoughtSpot.

sources.title: Metabase Open Source Analytics Platform
sources.notes: Free open-source self-hosted BI tool. Cloud plans: €85/month (5 users), Pro $20/user/month (unlimited users, 2 workspaces), embedded add-on $500/month/50 viewers.

sources.title: LlamaIndex: Data Framework for LLM Applications
sources.notes: Free open-source RAG framework. LlamaCloud managed parsing/indexing: credit-based model starting $50/month (40K credits). Free tier available for production use.

sources.title: LangChain: Build LLM Applications
sources.notes: Free open-source framework. LangSmith tracing: free (5K traces/month), Plus $39/seat/month. Includes distributed tracing, evaluation, deployment for AI agents.

sources.title: Tableau Pricing: Cloud Standard, Creator, Explorer Plans
sources.notes: Enterprise BI tool. Cloud Viewer $15/user/month (annual), Explorer $42/user/month, Creator $75/user/month. Desktop Creator starts at $2,035/user/year. Premium positioning vs Power BI at 3-5x cost.

sources.title: Microsoft Power BI Pricing: Free, Pro, Premium
sources.notes: Free tier (local), Pro $14/user/month (April 2025 price increase), Premium Per User $24/user/month. Dominant in Microsoft ecosystem; deep Excel/Office integration.

sources.title: Retool Low-Code Internal Tools Platform Pricing
sources.notes: Low-code internal tool builder. Self-hosted free, Cloud: $10-50/user/month. Positioned for complex enterprise workflows + AI-native features.

sources.title: Budibase Open-Source Low-Code Platform Pricing
sources.notes: Self-hosted free (unlimited users/apps). Cloud: Free (5 users, 20 automations/mo), Pro $5/user/month, Business $15/user/month, Enterprise custom. Per-creator + per-app-user model.

sources.title: Appsmith Open-Source Internal Tools Platform Pricing
sources.notes: Self-hosted free (unlimited users). Cloud: Free (3 users, limited features), Business $10/user/month, Enterprise $25/user/month. Git sync, audit logs at enterprise tier.

sources.title: Vector Database Cost Comparison 2026: Pinecone vs Weaviate vs Self-Hosted
sources.notes: Deep cost analysis: 10M vectors $70 (Qdrant) to $2.5K+ (Pinecone); 100M vectors $6K (self-hosted) to $28K (Pinecone). Pricing page vs actual bill gap 2.5-4x. Hidden costs: index rebuild, metadata storage, filtered search, cold-start, backup.

sources.title: Data Warehouse Pricing 2026: Snowflake vs BigQuery vs Redshift vs Databricks
sources.notes: Cloud data warehouse pricing models: Snowflake $2-5/credit + storage; BigQuery $6.25/TB scanned (ad-hoc); Redshift $0.543/hr provisioned or $1.50/hr serverless RPU. For 5TB/day: BigQuery ~$300/day, Snowflake $500-750/day, Redshift $730-820/day.

sources.title: Zapier Workflow Automation Pricing
sources.notes: Task-based billing. Team plan $69/month (2K tasks, 25 users), higher tiers $19.99+/month. Compared to Make: Zapier 4-15x more expensive at same workload; 60-70% more costly for high volumes.

sources.title: Airtable Database + Automation Platform Pricing
sources.notes: Free tier, Team $20/user/month (25K automations) or $24/user/month, Business $45/user/month (100K automations), Enterprise custom. Per-user + per-app-user model. 2.5x more expensive than Notion at team tier.

sources.title: Notion All-in-One Workspace Pricing
sources.notes: Free tier, Plus $10/user/month, Business $18/user/month. Positioned as document workspace with databases (vs Airtable's database-first). For 25-person team with SSO: saves $8,100/year vs Airtable.

sources.title: Supabase vs Firebase 2026: 3x Cost Gap Analysis
sources.notes: Backend-as-a-service comparison. Supabase Pro $25/month (8GB), Team $599/month; Firebase $50-200+/month for comparable scale. Supabase 3-5x cheaper for heavy workloads due to subscription vs pay-as-you-go model.

sources.title: Obsidian Knowledge Base & Graph Visualization Pricing
sources.notes: Free (personal), Catalyst $25 one-time (supporter), Sync $5/month, Publish $10/month, Commercial $50/user/year. Includes graph view, canvas, Bases database at no cost. 71% cheaper than Roam Research.

sources.title: Roam Research Knowledge Graph Tool Pricing
sources.notes: Monthly $15 or annual $165. Believer plan $500 for 5 years. Block-level reference granularity vs page-level linking. Premium knowledge graph positioning vs Obsidian.

sources.title: Gartner Top Predictions for Data and Analytics in 2026
sources.notes: Analyst predictions: AI expected to impact all D&A aspects (leadership, governance, talent, market dynamics). Analytics platforms market reached $48.6B 2025; five-year CAGR 15.5%. Data science/AI subsegment grew 38.6% in 2024.

sources.title: Technavio Business Intelligence Market Growth Analysis 2026-2030
sources.notes: Market forecast: BI market valued at $41.16B (2026), growing 8.67% CAGR to $62.38B (2031). Driven by data-driven decision-making demand and AI integration.

sources.title: Mordor Intelligence Global BI Market Report
sources.notes: Market size $34.82B (2025), projected $37.96B (2026) to $72.21B (2034), CAGR 8.40%. Growth drivers: digital transformation, advanced analytics adoption, generative AI.

sources.title: Fortune Business Insights Low-Code Platform Market 2026-2034
sources.notes: Low-code market $48.91B (2026) growing to $376.92B (2034), CAGR 29.10%. Driven by developer shortage and digital transformation urgency. 70% of new enterprise apps will use low-code/no-code by 2026.

sources.title: SoftwareAdvice Data Visualization Tools Reviews & Pricing
sources.notes: Aggregator review platform with verified pricing for Tableau, Power BI, Grafana, Looker, Qlik, SAP Analytics Cloud. Standard per-user-per-month tiering model documented.

sources.title: G2: Neo4j Graph Database Reviews & Pricing
sources.notes: Crowd review aggregator for Neo4j. Pricing for Community, Professional, Enterprise editions documented. Peer ratings and reviews (N=3,222+ respondents on Power BI).

sources.title: Capterra Data Visualization Software Reviews & Pricing Guide
sources.notes: Review aggregator with pricing comparisons for 30+ data visualization tools. Three pricing tiers identified based on starting price. User reviews and feature comparisons.

sources.title: SaaSworthy: Tableau vs Power BI vs Grafana Pricing Comparison
sources.notes: Side-by-side pricing comparison with features, integrations, and use case analysis. Highlights: Power BI $14/mo dominates cost; Grafana $0-29/mo targets DevOps; Tableau $15-75/mo for analytics.

sources.title: The Data Warehouse TCO: True Cost of Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift
sources.notes: Deep TCO analysis of cloud data warehouses including hidden costs (egress, storage classes, concurrency, administration). Reveals actual vs advertised pricing gaps.

sources.title: SaaS Pricing Playbook 2026: $100M+ ARR Companies' Models
sources.notes: Practitioner insights on pricing evolution in 2026. Usage-based adoption trends, hybrid model dominance (61%), per-user fatigue, AI pricing challenges, negotiated discounts.

sources.title: Optifai: B2B SaaS ACV Benchmarks (939 Companies)
sources.notes: Primary source for SaaS pricing benchmarks: median ACV $26K, SMB $5-15K, mid-market $10-50K, enterprise $50K-250K+. ACV growth 15-25% YoY, CAC payback varies with ACV tier.

sources.title: SaaS Pricing Shift 2026: Why Usage-Based Models Are Beating Subscriptions
sources.notes: Market trend analysis: 61% B2B SaaS companies use consumption-based pricing (up from 27% in 2020). Usage-based companies 137% net dollar retention, hybrid models 21% growth rate.

sources.title: SaaS Free Trial vs Freemium: Conversion Models in 2026
sources.notes: Freemium conversion 2-5% of free users, trial-to-paid 18.5% median. Hybrid (freemium + premium trial) fastest-growing 65% PLG adoption. Slack/Notion reducing free tier features Q2 2025.

sources.title: OpenHelm: Retool vs Budibase vs Appsmith Comparison
sources.notes: Comparative analysis: Retool enterprise-focused ($10-50/user/mo), Appsmith more accessible ($10-25/user/mo), Budibase cost-effective ($5-15/user/mo). Feature sets and pricing models compared for AI workflow builders.

sources.title: 25 Best Low-Code Platforms for 2026 (Tried and Tested)
sources.notes: Comprehensive low-code platform survey with pricing tiers, feature comparisons. Market size $44.5B (Gartner 2026), 19% annual growth, 70% adoption target by enterprises.

sources.title: Airtable vs Notion 2026: 2.5x Price Gap and Feature Analysis
sources.notes: Detailed pricing comparison: Airtable $20-45/user/month vs Notion $10-18/user/month. 2.5x premium for Airtable's relational database focus. Cost analysis for team scaling scenarios.

sources.title: Cassandra vs DynamoDB vs MongoDB: Pricing & Performance 2026
sources.notes: NoSQL pricing breakdown: DynamoDB $1K/year (small), Cassandra $3K/year (distributed setup costs), MongoDB Atlas $3.5K/year comparable scale. Self-hosted vs managed trade-offs documented.

sources.title: Vector DB Pricing Comparison 2026: Pinecone vs Weaviate Cost Analysis
sources.notes: Enterprise RAG infrastructure pricing: Pinecone Serverless ~$70/mo (10M), Weaviate Cloud ~$135/mo, self-hosted options 3-5x cheaper at scale. Detailed cost modeling per vector count.

sources.title: Why Vertical SaaS is Winning in 2026
sources.notes: Market trend: vertical SaaS 18-32% annual growth vs horizontal 12-15%, now 35% of SaaS revenue. Industry-specific pricing strategies, tiered by workflow + compliance needs. Usage-based adoption 85% in vertical SaaS.

sources.title: Graphistry: GPU-Accelerated Graph Visualization Platform
sources.notes: Enterprise graph visualization tool using server-side GPU rendering. Handles million-edge graphs interactively. Enterprise custom pricing model (not disclosed). Alternative to browser-based tools like Cytoscape.

sources.title: Cytoscape: Open Source Complex Network Analysis Platform
sources.notes: Open source software for complex network and graph visualization. Native support for BioPAX, SBML, PSI-MI biological data formats. Plugin ecosystem. Free self-hosted.

sources.title: Google Looker Studio: Free Data Visualization
sources.notes: Completely free tier with unlimited dashboards, 500+ connectors (Google Analytics, BigQuery, Sheets). Professional-grade but no cost. Dominates free/SMB segment.

sources.title: Grafana Open Source Monitoring & Visualization
sources.notes: Free open-source time-series visualization. Cloud plans $29-299/month. DevOps-focused with infrastructure monitoring specialization vs business analytics positioning.

sources.title: Redash: Open Source Query & Visualization
sources.notes: Free self-hosted BI tool. Paid cloud option available. SQL query interface + dashboards. Competes with Metabase and Superset in open-source analytics space.

sources.title: Apache Superset: Modern Data Visualization Platform
sources.notes: Free open-source BI. Managed version Preset available via SaaS. Wins on scale and visualization variety vs Metabase. Managed version custom pricing.

sources.title: Preset: Managed Apache Superset SaaS
sources.notes: Fully-managed Superset with support. Custom pricing model. Bridges open-source economics with SaaS features (support, SLA, compliance).

sources.title: Qlik Sense Analytics Platform Pricing
sources.notes: Named Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader. Cloud pricing $24-50/user/month. Associative analytics engine differentiates. Enterprise custom deals.

sources.title: Datadog vs New Relic: Observability Pricing Comparison 2026
sources.notes: Monitoring/observability tool pricing: Datadog $31/host/month for APM (fragmented billing), New Relic includes APM in base tier ($0.30-0.40/GB data ingestion). New Relic cheaper for heavy ingestion.

sources.title: Fiverr: Freelance Service Pricing Benchmarks
sources.notes: Marketplace pricing data for custom visualization/dashboard work. Rates $5-500+ per project reflect market rates for data visualization services.

sources.title: Open Source Software Monetization: Strategies in 2026
sources.notes: Open-core strategy (most common for dev tools): free core + paid enterprise features (security, compliance, support). GitLab example: Community Edition free, Ultimate $39/user/month. Global OSS services market $66.84B projected 2026.

sources.title: GitLab: Open-Core SaaS Pricing Model
sources.notes: Exemplar open-core model: Community Edition free, Premium $29/user/month, Ultimate $99-149/user/month. Buyer-based open-core (executives charge more). Executive-first sales motion.

sources.title: Elasticsearch: Open-Core Search & Analytics Pricing
sources.notes: Elastic Stack free open-source core, commercial features (security, machine learning, analytics) $9-180+/month. SaaS Elastic Cloud custom. Exemplar open-core licensing.

sources.title: Crunchbase vs PitchBook: Startup Pricing Database Comparison
sources.notes: Startup funding databases: Crunchbase Pro $588/year ($49/month), PitchBook $12K-70K/year (median $30K, average $56K). PitchBook depth on cap tables/valuations; Crunchbase for lead gen.

sources.title: Tiered Pricing Strategies: Complete Guide 2026
sources.notes: Pricing strategy guide: 3-4 tiers standard practice (free/starter/pro/enterprise). Gap between winners and bottom-quartile apps 400x in revenue. Feature differentiation by tier.

sources.title: Tableau Pricing Deep Dive: Full Cost Analysis
sources.notes: Comprehensive Tableau cost breakdown. Cloud Standard $15-75/user/month (viewer/explorer/creator). Desktop $2K+/year/user. Premium positioning vs Power BI 50% cost gap documented.

sources.title: Knowledge Graph Tools & Research Mapping Platforms 2026
sources.notes: Survey of knowledge graph visualization tools including Obsidian, Roam, Logseq, Heptabase. Pricing ranges $0-500+ one-time to $15-20/month. Graph visualization quality comparison.

sources.title: LlamaIndex Agents 2026: Pricing & Getting Started
sources.notes: LlamaIndex RAG framework pricing: free open-source, LlamaCloud managed parsing $50+/month (credit-based). Feature set and cost comparison with LangChain for document processing.

sources.title: LangSmith Pricing 2026: Free, Plus, Enterprise Tiers
sources.notes: LangSmith developer observability: free (5K traces/month), Plus $39/seat/month, Enterprise custom. Trace limits and data retention by tier.

sources.title: Firebase vs Supabase 2026: Backend-as-a-Service Comparison
sources.notes: Backend pricing: Firebase Blaze pay-as-you-go (cost spikes), Supabase fixed base + usage $25-599/month. Supabase cheaper for internal tools with idle databases. Cold-start latency penalties discussed.

sources.title: G2 Acquires Capterra: Vendor Pricing & Review Consolidation
sources.notes: G2 acquisition of Capterra (Jan 2026) consolidates software review platforms. Separate pricing models: Capterra $500/month PPC floor, G2 $2,999+/year subscription. Impact on vendor reviews and pricing transparency.

sources.title: Forrester: SaaS Market Trends & Forecasts 2026
sources.notes: Analyst firm forecasts on SaaS market growth, pricing model adoption, buyer behavior. AI software growth 50% faster than overall software market. Usage-based pricing accelerating.

sources.title: Gartner Data & Analytics Insights: Market Size & Trends
sources.notes: Gartner market intelligence on analytics platforms, CAGR forecasts, competitive positioning. Data-driven decision-making as primary market driver.

sources.title: IDC Analytics: Data Integration & Warehouse Adoption 2026
sources.notes: Analyst data on enterprise adoption of cloud data warehouses. Integration patterns, workload migrations, cost management. Market sizing for Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift segment.
